cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The escape-room attendant found our shortcut. Phase one is working.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made me distract her so you could crawl through it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. She was supposed to feel she'd caught us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's throwing us out. We haven't solved a single clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the fast exit I planned. Ask her to put our time on the leaderboard; solving clues was only our cover.
